dataset: Per-instance outputs of HELM Classic release v0.4.0 (Stanford CRFM): every synthetic_reasoning run listed in runs_to_run_suites.json, test split, all trials. Only run names, instance ids, trials, classes, counts and public model names are published.
note: qem = HELM's quasi_exact_match (the column's main metric, shown as EM); em = HELM's exact_match; oa = operator-aware: quasi-exact AND the same sequence of + - * = characters as the gold. blind = quasi-exact credits that are not operator-aware (classes: ops_missing, ops_reordered, ops_other). A cell is the mean of a model's trial-level means over the three modes. Ranks: higher is better, 1 + number of models strictly higher.
